trap.label: arising from
trap.wrong: Damages arisen from the breach are capped.
trap.right: Damages arising from the breach are capped.
trap.why: O português usa o particípio (“decorrentes”) e o aluno escolhe arisen. Em inglês jurídico, a oração reduzida ativa é arising from.

fix.wrong: The clause is applied irrespective the breach.
fix.right: The clause applies irrespective of the breach.

fix.wrong: Issues which merit to attention are listed.
fix.right: Issues which merit attention are listed.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com irrespective of: “No matter the cause, the cap applies.”
rewrite.answer: Irrespective of the cause, the cap applies.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com arising from: “Damages caused by the breach are capped.”
rewrite.answer: Damages arising from the breach are capped.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva mais simples: “Kindly revert by Friday.” (Please reply…)
